mapper.update: update t_user set nature_sort=(CASE WHEN id_auth='3' and TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) < 18 THEN 7 WHEN id_auth='3' and TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 18 AND 21 THEN 6 WHEN id_auth='3' and TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 22 AND 25 THEN 5 WHEN id_auth='3' and TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 26 AND 29 THEN 4 WHEN id_auth='3' and TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 30 AND 33 THEN 3 WHEN id_auth='3' and TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 34 AND 37 THEN 2 WHEN id_auth='3' and TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 38 AND 41 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
